title: Smith Machine Calf Raise
summary: A standing calf raise with the bar on your back, done on a step for full range.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for calves (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly calves total.

setup.text: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a step or plate.
Lower your heels as far as you can and pause in the stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.

form_cues.cue: Lower the heels to a full stretch
Rise onto the balls of your feet
Pause for a second at the bottom. The stretch is where calves grow most.

mistakes.text: Bending the knees to bounce the weight.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
